newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen stock Jan-Oct turnover seen 800 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen stock Jan-Oct turnover seen 800 bln yuan.

text.p: Turnover of domestic A shares and foreign currency B shares together with fund trading on the Shenzhen stock exchange was expected to hit a record 800 billion yuan for the first 10 months, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Wednesday.
Total turnover for the year reached 799.86 billion yuan as of Tuesday, sharply higher than the combined turnover in the past five years, the newspaper said.

Shenzhen bourse's total turnover between 1990 and 1995 reached about 580 billion yuan, accounting for only about 70 percent of the figure expected for the first 10 months of 1996, the newspaper said. The Shenzhen bourse was set up in 1990.

Shenzhen's A share index has surged more than 200 percent since early April when Beijing started to ease its three-year-old credit squeeze with a cut in interest rates to close on Tuesday at 391.03 points, it said.
The bullish trade was coupled with a rapid expansion of the southern China stock market. China's other bourse is in Shanghai.

The newspaper said more than 70 firms had offered or listed A or B shares in Shenzhen this year and raised nine billion yuan. The number of Shenzhen-listed stock investors also increased steeply this year. About 8.33 million new investors opened trading accounts in Shenzhen this year, the newspaper said, but gave no comparative figure.
